Los Cármenes — Madrid, Spain

In detail

Local press has documented persistent narcopisos and street-level drug trafficking in Los Carmenes since at least 2015, with resident associations repeatedly protesting between 2018 and 2022. A November 2022 investigation found the problem 'is not a thing of the past', naming a specific street as a hotspot near the boundary with neighbouring Lucero. No reporting of muggings or violent street crime beyond drug-related activity was found specifically here. Sources checked: Madridiario, Nov 2022; Telemadrid, Nov 2018; Guiadealuche.net, Apr 2018.
